name: Energy Display
description: A battery-powered display that shows the power, monthly cost and monthly energy of up to three iMeters, and the room temperature.

verification.note: Read from the Energy Display 2448A2 Owner's Manual, which has the display's SET button held before the meter's, and from the display reading the meter in each group.

Read from the Energy Display 2448A2 Owner's Manual, which has the display's SET button held before the meter's, and from the display reading the meter in each group.
The Energy Display 2448A2 Owner's Manual only lets the SET button link meters 1 to 3; the Energy Display Developer Notes link group 4 to a modem.

steps.text: Make sure at least one dual-band Insteon device and an Insteon meter device, such as the Power Meter 2423A1, are installed.
Remove the battery compartment door from the rear of Energy Display.
Observing the polarity markings, install two AAA batteries, then replace the battery compartment door.
steps.expect: The screen turns on with all LCD segments lit, and after a few seconds goes to Display Mode

notes: Two AAA batteries last approximately one year.

steps.text: Tap the 1-2-3/Down button until the meter position you want (Meter 1, 2 or 3) is blinking.
Press and hold the SET button until Energy Display beeps (3 seconds).
Within 4 minutes, press and hold the meter device's SET button until it beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: Energy Display double-beeps, its status LED turns off, and a few moments later the screen shows the meter's information

notes: Energy Display goes first and controls the meter position; each position holds one device, and linking a second device to a position replaces the first.
The Developer Notes also allow a PowerLinc Modem in groups 1 to 3, and in group 4 for temperature broadcasts.

steps.text: Use the 1-2-3/Down button to select the meter device you want to unlink.
Press and hold the SET button until Energy Display beeps (3 seconds).
Press and hold the SET button again until it beeps (3 seconds).
Within 4 minutes, press and hold the meter device's SET button until it beeps (3 seconds).
Confirm on the screen that the meter's information is no longer displayed.

notes: Unlink meter devices you no longer use; otherwise Energy Display keeps trying to reach them, slowing the system and shortening battery life.

steps.text: Press the Synchronize button so Energy Display requests status from its linked meters.
steps.expect: After the last meter responds, Energy Display stays awake for 3 seconds before sleeping

steps.text: Within those 3 seconds, send the Stayawake On command (0x20 with command 2 set to 0x06) to keep it awake for 4 minutes so settings and links can be programmed.

notes: Stayawake Off (0x20 with command 2 set to 0x07) ends the awake period early.

verification.note: From the Developer Notes, which name a Synchronize button; the Energy Display 2448A2 Owner's Manual names a Refresh button that retrieves data, which is likely the same button.

steps.text: Unlink any meter devices from Energy Display.
Remove the battery compartment cover on the back of Energy Display.
Remove one battery for at least 10 seconds.
While holding down the SET button, reinsert the battery, making sure not to let go of the SET button.
steps.expect: The screen turns on with all LCD segments lit

steps.text: Continue to hold the SET button until the screen goes blank (10 seconds), then release it.
steps.expect: Energy Display beeps; after a few more seconds it beeps again and, after a few flashes, the screen returns to Display Mode

notes: A factory reset does not reset the meter devices linked to Energy Display.
Linking a second meter in a group replaces the first.

verification.note: The display controls group 4 and reads the meters in groups 1 to 3; no document says it responds to a group.
